build: Official Nighty Night Update patch record
observations: Benefits Package grants armored enemies named perks including teleport, armor, pull fields, ally protection, damage, speed, and damaging links.
Certain perks were explicitly banned from incompatible foe types.
Routine Inspection disables Mirror talents in ordered groups rather than changing enemy health alone.
The same update distinguishes challenge modifiers from the Permanent Record and other progression state.
inferences: Variant generation needs compatibility rules as well as a perk pool.
Behavioral mutation and player-capability restriction test different skills and should remain separately measurable.
limits: Patch notes establish rule existence, not exact live frequencies or causal enjoyment.
Later Hades versions can supersede early-access balance.
